_comment: go_shadow.sh copies this to /etc/ghostwall/ghost_dns.json and fills in the query log, the threat feed and the paths under /var/lib/ghostwall. Inline mode (Ghostwall answers DNS and can block) is in docs/OPERATIONS.md: only after a week of clean shadow results.
_sinkhole_note: 0.0.0.0 = null route (client can't connect). Set to this box's LAN IP instead if you want blocked domains to hit a page served here.
